async def act(page):
    # Click the Sales link in the menubar to open the Sales menu
    await page.get_by_role("menubar").get_by_role("link", name="Sales").click()
    await page.wait_for_timeout(1000)  # Wait for menu to expand
    
    # Click the Orders link in the Sales submenu (assuming it appears after clicking Sales)
    # Since the accessibility tree doesn't show submenu items, I'll use a common selector
    # In Magento Admin, the Orders link is typically under Sales -> Orders
    await page.get_by_role("link", name="Orders", exact=True).click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    
    # On the Orders page, apply filter for status 'Processing'
    # First, locate the status filter dropdown (assuming it's a select element)
    status_filter = page.get_by_role("combobox", name="Status")
    await status_filter.click()
    await status_filter.select_option("processing")
    
    # Click the search or apply filter button (common in Magento)
    await page.get_by_role("button", name="Search").click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    
    # Retrieve the results (list of processing orders)
    # Assuming results are in a table, get all rows
    orders_table = page.get_by_role("table")
    rows = await orders_table.get_by_role("row").all()
    
    # Extract order data from each row (skip header row)
    orders = []
    for row in rows[1:]:  # Skip the first row if it's the header
        cells = await row.get_by_role("cell").all()
        if cells:
            order_info = {
                "order_id": await cells[0].inner_text(),
                "customer": await cells[1].inner_text(),
                "status": await cells[2].inner_text(),
                "total": await cells[3].inner_text()
            }
            orders.append(order_info)
    
    # Return the list of processing orders as a string representation
    return str(orders)
